title: CSV/Excel Parser Configuration
description: Configuration schema for CSV and Excel parser

chunk_size.description: Size of text chunks. null means no chunking

chunk_overlap.description: Number of characters to overlap between chunks

chunk_strategy.description: Strategy for splitting data into chunks

convert_to.description: Format to convert table data to

sheet_names.description: Specific sheets to process. null means all sheets

max_rows.description: Maximum rows to process. null means all rows

summarize_large_tables.description: Add statistical summary for large tables
